title: Concept: Policy delivered only in markup
description: A content security policy carried in a meta element rather than a header in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A policy in the document applies only after the parser reaches it, so anything injected above the tag runs before the policy exists.
applicability: Deployments that render a content security policy carried in a meta element rather than a header into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A policy in the document applies only after the parser reaches it, so anything injected above the tag runs before the policy exists.
